{"metadata":{"description":"把文件拖入/粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness Web：输入框原生引用气泡，随消息发送（含绝对路径），气泡渲染文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI as native reference bubbles — absolute paths, file cards.","id":"gh:1334817013","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-drop-in","slug":"lbl61/dsh-drop-in","topics":["clipboard","deepseek-harness","drag-drop","dsh","dsh-plugin","electron","file","paste","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"把文件拖入/粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness Web：输入框原生引用气泡，随消息发送（含绝对路径），气泡渲染文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rness web GUI as native reference bubbles — absolute paths, file cards."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-drop-in"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 🌐 中文版：README.zh.md"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Drag files from your system file manager straight into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
Files appear as"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" a chip bar above the input box, or — with the composer focused — as a
**native reference bubble** ("},{"id":"p4s3","text":"file pill) embedded inline in the text you are typing; they
are sent along with your message (includ"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ing their **absolute paths**), and render as
file cards inside the user bubble. The agent reads the "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"real file paths — no upload, no
content copy (plain-browser fallback copies small files into the wor"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"e paths — no upload, no
content copy (plain-browser fallback copies small files into the workspace)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 📎 Drag in **any file/folder** (images are treated as files — the official image-drop overlay no lo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nger steals the drag)
- 🫧 **Inline file bubble**: dropped/pasted files are inserted at the caret as "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"a native reference pill (works mid-text); the pill shows **`TYPE name`** (e.g. `LNK 坚果云.lnk` — the t"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ype survives name clipping, full name on hover)
- 📤 **Path on send**: the pill expands to a referenc"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"e carrying the **absolute path** (`@filename`); the chat bubble renders it as a file card with a typ"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"e badge — the agent can read the file straight from the path
- 🔀 Messages sent while the agent is ru"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"nning ("interrupt-free") render the same file cards
- 🖼️ **Clipboard paste**: pasting an image/file "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"into the composer goes through the same pipeline instead of the native image-attachment rail; pasted"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" binaries are persisted (base64) under `.dsh-drops/<sessionId>/`
- 🚀 Chip bar above the input: icon "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"+ name + size + path status, removable (×), deduplicated by path
- ✔️ Enter / Ctrl+Enter / the send "},{"id":"p6s11","text":"button are all covered; chips clear automatically after sending
- 🔍 A `dropped_files` tool lets the "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"agent list still-unsent dropped files
- 🖥️ Under DSH Desktop (Electron) absolute paths come from the"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" preload bridge (`webUtils.getPathForFile` — the only path source in modern Electron)
- 🌐 Fallback: "},{"id":"p6s14","text":"in a plain browser (no preload bridge) text files are copied to the workspace `.dsh-drops/`"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Manual (bundle) install:
1. Extract `dsh-drop-in` into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-drop-in"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"/`
2. Add `"dsh-drop-in"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
3"},{"id":"p9s3","text":". Restart `dsh web` (DSH Desktop: quit fully and reopen, or run `window.dshDesktop.restartService()`"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"h web` (DSH Desktop: quit fully and reopen, or run `window.dshDesktop.restartService()` in DevTools)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### DSH Desktop: enable absolute paths (required for path features)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Absolute paths come from a preload bridge that lives in the **DSH Desktop shell**, not in
this plugi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"n. Modern DSH Desktop packs its preload into `resources/app.asar`, so a plain
file patch no longer w"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"orks — and **every DSH Desktop update wipes the bridge**. Run the
bundled injector:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop. Without it, chips still appear but read
"无法读取路径" (no path) a"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nd the agent cannot read the files. See
preload-bridge.md."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For a plain browser (no Electron shell) there is no bridge by design; text files fall
back to being "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"copied into `.dsh-drops/<sessionId>/` in the workspace."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. Drag files from Explorer into the chat page (or paste an image/file into the composer)
2. Compose"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"r focused → files are inserted at the caret as **native reference bubbles** (file pills), mid-text a"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"llowed; otherwise they appear in the chip bar above the input
3. Type your message and send (Enter /"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" Ctrl+Enter / the send button all work; "interrupt-free" sending while the agent runs is supported t"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"oo)
4. The bubble shows file cards — the agent receives the absolute path (`@name` or the `📎 拖入文件` b"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"lock) and can read the files"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The client half intercepts file drags in the capture phase (the official image-upload flow never s"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"teals the events), keeps a per-session chip bar (`conversation.input.dock`), renders user bubbles wi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"th file cards (`conversation.chat.node` `user`/`steering` keys), and stitches the `📎 拖入文件` block int"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"o the draft before submit (Enter, Ctrl+Enter, and the send button are all covered); with the compose"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"r focused it inserts **native reference bubbles** via the `slash/input-insert-reference` scoped even"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"t (U+FFFC occurrences rendered by the composer backdrop) and the registered `inputTriggers` codec se"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"rializes them to `@filename` on submit
- The host half keeps the per-session file registry behind th"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"e `dropped_files` tool, writes fallback text copies to `.dsh-drops/<sessionId>/`, and persists paste"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"d binaries via the `file-copy` route (base64, with an explicit workspace-write sandbox policy rooted"},{"id":"p18s10","text":" at the session cwd)
- Absolute paths under DSH Desktop rely on the preload bridge (see preload-brid"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ge.md): Electron ≥ 32 removed `File.path`"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Setting | Description |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `enabled` | Master switch (Settings → 文件拖入). When off, drag/paste falls back to built-in behavior."},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`enabled` | Master switch (Settings → 文件拖入). When off, drag/paste falls back to built-in behavior. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. Remove `dsh-drop-in` from the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
2"},{"id":"p23s2","text":". Delete `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-drop-in/`
3. Restart `dsh web`"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
